description: Source code for the 'ECB' class in the OpenCart admin extension, responsible for handling currency-related operations via ECB endpoints, including loading currency data, saving configurations, and updating currency exchange rates.

classes.name: ECB
classes.description: Controller class for handling currency exchange rate updates and configuration management via ECB in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the currency ECB configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and loading necessary controllers for header, footer, and side columns.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the updated currency exchange rates fetched from ECB, performing permission checks, processing POST data, and updating currency values accordingly.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Retrieves and updates currency exchange rates based on ECB data, optionally using a default currency parameter.
